scenarios.causalMutation: Mutate Runtime/UI/Unity gameplay systems/public GamePackage schema.

diagnostics.message: Broad Runtime/UI/Unity/GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit destruction without a building id.

diagnostics.message: Destruction/damage must affect a declared structure.

scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate settlement or building id across rows.

diagnostics.message: Settlement and building ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a family id outside the accepted matrix.

diagnostics.message: Family id must come from the accepted matrix.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a seed id outside seed_alpha/beta/gamma.

diagnostics.message: Seed id must come from the accepted matrix.

scenarios.causalMutation: Place a building on an unsupported footprint.

diagnostics.message: Building footprint must be supported and placement must be allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Spend more construction resources than available.

diagnostics.message: Construction costs must leave non-negative resources.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit production with no positive output.

diagnostics.message: Production output must increase at least one resource/service value.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the Goal 065 interlocked gameplay row.

diagnostics.message: Goal 065 interlocked gameplay source is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove Goal 065 deltas from a settlement dependency.

diagnostics.message: Living-world linkage is required for every settlement row.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove matching Goal 062 spatial detail row.

diagnostics.message: Goal 062 spatial detail source is required.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit rows by filesystem enumeration order.

diagnostics.message: Rows must be sorted by family and seed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, LLM, RAG or media generation.

diagnostics.message: Provider, LLM, RAG and media generation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Repair a structure that was not damaged.

diagnostics.message: Repair/upgrade/defense response requires prior damage or threat pressure.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use traversal or absolute path in a source/staging path.

diagnostics.message: Paths must stay repository-relative and traversal-free.
